name: What tools are used for drywall sanding?

mainEntity.name: What tools are used for drywall sanding?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common tools for drywall sanding include hand sanders, sanding poles with abrasive sheets or screens, and electric sanders like orbital sanders or drywall sanders with vacuum attachments. For manual sanding, 100-150 grit sandpaper is typically used. Electric sanders offer efficiency for larger areas and often feature dust collection systems, which significantly reduce airborne dust. The choice of tool depends on the project size, desired finish, and dust control preferences.
acceptedAnswer.description: Tools for drywall sanding range from hand sanders and sanding poles to electric orbital or drywall sanders, often with dust collection, using 100-150 grit sandpaper.
